# Little Kit

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** House of Dreams  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Kit  <sub>[v5 c3 P4](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0004), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>; Little Kit  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Kit has curly red hair like his mother and open hazel eyes like his father. He has a fine nose and a steady, humorous mouth. He is the only member of his family whose ears satisfy Tabitha, and he considers himself to be 'awful big' rather than little.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009)_

## Personality

Kit is a dependable, solid, and practical boy who never breaks promises. He speaks little and prefers testing the truth of statements through personal experience rather than taking things on trust. He possesses a vast knowledge of nature, outdoor skills, and his surroundings through keen observation. He dislikes giving thanks before meals and detests being called 'Little Kit'.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c3 P28](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0028)_

## Traits

- Dependable  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Observant  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Practical and experimental  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Solid, well-rounded academic skills  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Imitating wild bird and animal calls  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Outdoor survival skills such as fishing, cooking, reading fortune using daisy petals, and finding wild flowers and spruce-gum  <sub>[v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>

## History

Kit grew up as the eldest son of his family, being the only one born at the House of Dreams. On his eighth birthday, he protested against being called 'Little Kit', prompting his mother to stop using the nickname around him. At school, he earned the status of a chieftain among his peers. He enjoyed spending time with his siblings at Fern Hollow, where he hung a strand of old sleigh-bells on the 'Tree Lovers' trees and frequently cooked trout over an open fire for their outdoor feasts.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P4](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0004), [v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009), [v5 c3 P10](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0010), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)_

## Background by volume

- Only child in the family born at the House of Dreams rather than Hollowmere  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- Once tested if a frost-covered latch would rip skin off his tongue, resulting in a painful tongue for days  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>

## Quotes

> Mother, I’m not little any more. I’m awful big.  <sub>[v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009)</sub>

> Frying the trout was my job. Let Edmund recite it, since he enjoys reciting grace. Also, make it brief, Walt, because I am famished.  <sub>[v5 c3 P28](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0028)</sub>
